complete_parent_enumeration.recursion: For every retained isomorphism type A, compute its 3-cover A*, 3-multiplicator M, nucleus U, and Aut(A)-orbits of every allowable subgroup L<=M with LU=M and |M:L| no larger than the remaining order budget; emit A*/L, deduplicate by the p-group generation orbit theorem, and continue through order 3^8.
safe_branch_pruning: discard an ancestor whose exponent exceeds 9
discard an ancestor whose complete literal cube set is not a subgroup
complete_parent_enumeration.final_filter: At order 3^8 retain exactly the groups satisfying parent_predicate.
complete_parent_enumeration.completeness_reason: Every finite 3-group has a unique lower-exponent-3 parent and an iterated parent chain ending at an elementary abelian root. Literal cube-set subgroup closure and exponent at most 9 pass to every quotient, so the two branch prunes cannot remove an ancestor of a qualifying parent. All allowable step sizes, not only step size one, are required before order 3^8.

central_descendant_count.method: For each retained Q, compute Aut(Q)-orbits on the allowable hyperplanes L of its 3-multiplicator M which do not contain the nucleus U; each orbit gives one order-3^9 immediate descendant.
central_descendant_count.raw_hyperplane_bound_per_parent: If dim_F3(M)=m and dim_F3(U)=u, the number before Aut(Q)-fusion is (3^m-3^(m-u))/2.
